question: Do the character PW projections support an actual order-of-limits theorem, rather than only a scalar character substitution?
current_answer: Yes. The actual finite-level trace contains all eta zeros strictly left of the upper strip edge; reversing the two iterated limits removes those at or left of the lower edge. The exact difference is the negative lower-exterior zero distribution.
method: Actual Hardy quotient, uniform Malmquist S1 factorization, endpoint/cusp ambient lift and trace-norm cutoffs.
remaining_work: A joint position/band limit and the geometric asymptotic of its Gram correction remain separate; no LF lift is inferred.
